all.name: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS
all.role: Builds the shared libgit2 link unit; declared by the top-level CMakeLists.txt.

all.name: BUILD_TESTS
all.role: Builds the clar regression suite; declared by the top-level CMakeLists.txt.

all.name: BUILD_CLI
all.role: Builds the separate git2 command-line executable; declared by the top-level CMakeLists.txt and disabled because it is outside this library campaign.

all.name: DEPRECATE_HARD
all.role: Excludes deprecated API implementations; declared by the top-level CMakeLists.txt and left disabled because the requested wrapper-reached surface still includes deprecated functions.

all.name: USE_THREADS
all.role: Enables the platform threading provider; the top-level CMakeLists.txt documents the default as ON.

all.name: USE_SSH
all.role: Enables SSH transports; the top-level CMakeLists.txt documents the default as OFF.

all.name: USE_HTTP
all.role: Enables HTTP transport support; the top-level CMakeLists.txt documents the default as ON.

all.name: USE_HTTPS
all.role: Selects an HTTPS provider; the top-level CMakeLists.txt documents the default as ON, but this dependency-free sanitizer build disables it.

all.name: USE_SHA1
all.role: Selects the SHA-1 provider; SelectHashes.cmake maps the default to the bundled collision-detecting implementation.

all.name: USE_SHA256
all.role: Selects the SHA-256 provider; SelectHashes.cmake uses the bundled implementation when HTTPS is disabled.

all.name: USE_HTTP_PARSER
all.role: Selects the HTTP parser; SelectHTTPParser.cmake uses the bundled llhttp implementation by default.

all.name: USE_AUTH_NTLM
all.role: Enables NTLM authentication; the top-level CMakeLists.txt leaves it provider-selected, while this HTTPS-free build disables it.

all.name: USE_AUTH_NEGOTIATE
all.role: Enables SPNEGO authentication; the top-level CMakeLists.txt leaves it provider-selected, while this dependency-free build disables it.

all.name: USE_REGEX
all.role: Selects the regular-expression provider; SelectRegex.cmake probes system providers, while this build fixes the bundled implementation for reproducibility.

all.name: USE_COMPRESSION
all.role: Selects zlib; SelectCompression.cmake falls back to bundled sources, which this build selects explicitly.

test_baseline: 3/3 passed. Disabled from the 12-test CTest inventory: offline (upstream SHA1DC misaligned-load UBSan failure), invasive (same), gitdaemon (ASan crash), gitdaemon_sha256 (intermittent ASan crash), online (requires disabled TLS and reports leak fallout), proxy (requires disabled TLS), auth_clone (requires disabled TLS), auth_clone_and_push (intermittent ASan crash), util (ASan crash). Leak detection is disabled for the retained Clar processes; ASan and UBSan instrumentation remain enabled.
